text:
Maya: Quick heads up — Nebula beta kickoff is scheduled for Thu 10am PT. Need final headcount (attendees + observers) and the top 2-3 success scenarios they want us to demo.
Priya: I can confirm 4 active users + 2 observers from their ML team. Asking product about the exact prompts they want to try.
Jordan: tagging @Priya — if they want streaming demo we should mirror their seq lengths; ask for sample inputs.
Alex: I've got a sample prompt pack we used for other pilots, will upload in #cs-resources in a sec.
Sam: Ops checklist: are they doing S3 data pull or API ingest? That changes the pre-kickoff ops work.
Maya: They said API ingest. We need API keys, CORS allowlist, and an IP range for their VPC egress.
Priya: I'll collect keys from their infra lead today and confirm CORS.
Jordan: Product note — there is a minor bug where long system messages sometimes truncate in streaming; not blocker but looks bad in demo. Can eng triage a patch? @Alex FYI.
Alex: I'll open a small PR for the streaming truncation fix, should be low risk. ETA EOD tomorrow.
OpsBot: Reminder: Beta onboarding checklist (3 items remaining): 1) API keys 2) Observability dashboard invite 3) Enablement session scheduled.
Sam: Observability invite — do we have the Nebula email list? If not, Maya please send.
Maya: Sending list now. Also flagging a potential renewal risk: Nebula mentioned tight budget next quarter; want to measure time-to-value in first 2 weeks. We should define 2 quick metrics for success.
Priya: Proposed metrics: (1) avg latency for 95th pct under their typical payload, (2) accuracy on 50 eval prompts (they care about hallucination).
Jordan: Agreed. I'll add a short eval set and a dashboard template we can reuse.
Alex: For feedback loop — I'll prepare a 3-question post-demo micro-survey (ease of use, fidelity, blockers) and share link.
Maya: Perfect. Can we also schedule a 30min enablement session right after the kickoff? Practical how-to + where to see logs.
Sam: Slot booked: Thu 11:00-11:30 PT (calendar invite sent).
Priya: Confirmed. I'll run the enablement and capture the survey results live.
Maya: One more ops ask — can we enable temporary elevated logs for their account for the first 48h? CCing infra team.
Alex: We can do 48h retention bump for logs — will coordinate with infra after PR lands.
Maya: Awesome. Last thing — capture all of this in the Nebula pilot ticket and mark "renewal_risk: medium". I'll update CRM.
Jordan: Thanks team — this feels ready. If any blockers surface, post here and loop me in. :thumbsup:
Priya: Will post sample prompts and the prompt pack link in 30m.
OpsBot: Checklist updated by Sam: items left = 0.
Maya: Closing the loop — prepping a short pre-kickoff email to Nebula with agenda + survey link, will send in 2 hours.
